run_gemini_oauth_login_pure: run the Google OAuth PKCE login flow and return a dict with access_token, refresh_token, expires_at_ms, email, and project_id
start_oauth_flow: start an interactive browser-based Google OAuth flow with PKCE and persist the resulting credentials to disk
get_valid_access_token: load stored Google OAuth credentials and return a valid access token, refreshing if near expiry
refresh_access_token: refresh a Google OAuth access token using a refresh token and return the new token response
load_credentials: load Google OAuth credentials from disk and return a GoogleCredentials object or None if missing or corrupt
